1.explanation:
• nav/index.md & nav/index.en-us.md describe Nav props (including mode=iconOnly) and overall behavior.
• nav/demo/icon-only.md shows the exact example of iconOnly usage and highlights the empty-item issue.
• nav/demo/basic.md provides the default Nav.Item rendering for comparison (text+icon vs. iconOnly).
• nav/demo/popup-align.md demonstrates the overflow popup rendering where the blank placeholders are visible.
• nav/theme/index.jsx contains the styling and render logic for Nav items and the overflow popup, so it’s necessary to locate where iconless items are still being rendered and reserve space.
1.bug_scenario: When Nav is used with mode="iconOnly", any Nav.Item that doesn’t have an icon configured still reserves space and renders as an empty row, leading to a column of blank slots in the vertical bar. In the overflow popup (shown in the red box) these empty items appear as blank placeholders instead of being omitted or showing their labels.
